__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus datasource for Codex session telemetry

panels.title: Collection
panels.description: Current means the source is available and the collector scan at the selected range end is less than 20 seconds old. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) * 2) + on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < bool 20)

panels.title: Scan age
panels.description: Age of the most recent completed scan at the selected range end. Collector-global: ignores Project and Work. A stale scan remains visible; no completed scan or missing metrics is Unavailable. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: time() - (max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds) > 0)

panels.title: Errors / hour
panels.description: Collector error rate over the last hour, scaled to errors per hour. Whole profile. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: 3600 * (sum(rate(cwo_codex_collector_errors_total[1h])))

panels.title: Pending files
panels.description: Files waiting for the session collector to scan, across the whole profile. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: max(cwo_codex_collector_pending_files) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)

panels.title: Commands coverage
panels.description: Covered: fresh available source, replay complete, and the selected start is within retained command history. Partial: the values shown are lower bounds because history, parsing or export coverage is incomplete. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: (((max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_ready) == 1) and on () (max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_complete_after_timestamp_seconds) < $__from / 1000)) or (0 * max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_ready))) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)) < 20) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)

panels.title: Weekly remaining
panels.description: Account-wide shared Codex allowance at the selected range end. Project and Work filters do not apply. Read approximately every 60 seconds; values older than 150 seconds are unavailable. History starts when account collection is enabled. 100 minus the reported used percentage, rounded by the upstream service and floored at zero when usage reaches or exceeds 100%. Only a uniquely identified 10080-minute shared Codex window qualifies. This is not token headroom or a guarantee that requests are permitted. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: clamp_min(100 - max(cwo_codex_account_window_used_percent and on (job, instance, window) (cwo_codex_account_window_minutes == 10080)), 0) and on () (((max(cwo_codex_account_available) == 1) and on () (count(cwo_codex_account_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_account_last_success_timestamp_seconds)) >= 0) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_account_last_success_timestamp_seconds)) < 150)) and on () (count((cwo_codex_account_window_minutes == 10080)) == 1))

panels.title: Resets
panels.description: Account-wide shared Codex allowance at the selected range end. Project and Work filters do not apply. Read approximately every 60 seconds; values older than 150 seconds are unavailable. History starts when account collection is enabled. Uses the service-provided available count, never the number of returned credit details. Zero means no resets available; null stays unavailable. Monitoring does not redeem resets. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: max(cwo_codex_account_reset_credits_available) and on () ((max(cwo_codex_account_available) == 1) and on () (count(cwo_codex_account_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_account_last_success_timestamp_seconds)) >= 0) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_account_last_success_timestamp_seconds)) < 150))

panels.title: Next reset
panels.description: Account-wide shared Codex allowance at the selected range end. Project and Work filters do not apply. Read approximately every 60 seconds; values older than 150 seconds are unavailable. History starts when account collection is enabled. The date uses the dashboard timezone. The countdown is measured from the selected range end. A passed reset time means an updated observation is needed; it does not establish restored allowance. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: (max(cwo_codex_account_window_reset_timestamp_seconds and on (job, instance, window) (cwo_codex_account_window_minutes == 10080)) * 1000) and on () (((max(cwo_codex_account_available) == 1) and on () (count(cwo_codex_account_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_account_last_success_timestamp_seconds)) >= 0) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_account_last_success_timestamp_seconds)) < 150)) and on () (count((cwo_codex_account_window_minutes == 10080)) == 1))
